intent: Repair PR 801 hosted glass-rendering regressions and transient Robolectric provisioning failure, preserve adaptive pressure protection and checksum verification, then validate and publish on the existing branch.

failures.evidence: API 34 and 36 fail the same dialog blur and conversation backdrop detail, opacity and restoration assertions; blur-on and blur-off images are identical.
failures.diagnosis: The new process-wide emergency frame guard accepts first-draw stalls and depends on two complete healthy windows for recovery. Glass becomes unavailable under reduced effects. Logs do not independently identify the triggering frame.

failures.evidence: Provision verified Robolectric runtimes fails in urllib.request.urlopen with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; the same head passes PR Validation.
failures.diagnosis: The existing three attempts wait only 5 and 10 seconds, exhausting retries during shared-egress rate limiting. Server Retry-After is not honored.

acceptance: First-draw measurements cannot trigger runtime rendering-pressure fallback.
Genuine runtime stalls still reduce effects and repeated pressure extends the hold.
Reduced effects have a bounded recovery path on a quiet screen.
Glass opacity, blur and restoration assertions remain intact and pass on hosted API 34 and 36.
Provisioning retries only transient download failures with bounded waits and validates the existing pinned checksums.
Applicable hosted workflows pass for the published repair revision.

validation.result: 16 tests passed; publisher pins and permanent-failure safeguards retained.

validation.scope: Canonical host validation after both repairs
validation.result: 311 tests passed; CI policy, dependency catalog, secret scan, resource, Android regex and whitespace checks passed.
All 10 FrameEffectsGuardTest cases passed against unchanged guard and observation sources.
All eight changed/new Kotlin files passed.
Passed: stopped-listener fence, single handler-owned timer, latest-deadline recheck, idle and resume recovery, representative sample filtering.
BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 6m 16s; 12 tests passed, no failures/errors/skips; app and instrumentation Kotlin compilation passed. Repository Gradle memory limits retained.

qualification: Hosted emulators validate rendering contracts. No physical-device performance improvement, vendor qualification or external-service recovery is claimed.

implementation.rendering: Exclude first draws from adaptive pressure while retaining raw diagnostics. Preserve immediate critical-stall and sustained-pressure protection. Expire the latest 30-second hold independently of frame production, check expiry on resume, and reject callbacks from stopped observations.
implementation.pixel_acceptance: Fixtures use controlled instances of the real policy; all existing pixel assertions remain unchanged. Add a forced-chat pressure/fallback/idle-recovery regression including restored 0.15 and 0.50 transmission.
implementation.provisioning: Bounded six-attempt HTTP 429 recovery with Retry-After and jitter; original checksum pins and global deadline retained.
